added.summary: A development build's page takes re-cooked files ([path, bytes][]) and applies them in place without a hot reload (the world and bundle stay; only the changed documents, styles and default style are read again): an edited document, style or (in an origin-engine checkout) default style shows without reloading the page. It answers each step's time in ms. The UI gallery (docs/ui.md §6.5) uses it.
